support.title: Help Center
support.subtitle: Feature guides, FAQs & direct support
support.guideWelcomeBody: 6-step guide covering discovery, slot booking, QR check-in, charging sessions, and refunds.

discovery.title: 1. Discover & Pick the Right Station
discovery.summary: Search stations by map, distance, and connector types (CCS2, Type 2).
discovery.step1: Open the Map or Station List tab to view active stations around you.
discovery.step2: Filter by connector: CCS2 (DC fast 30kW–180kW) or Type 2 (AC standard 7kW–22kW).
discovery.step3: Check live status: Available (Green), In Use (Blue), Maintenance (Yellow), Full (Red).
discovery.tip: Tip: Tap on a station pin to view max power output and hourly pricing rates.

booking.title: 2. Pre-book a Charging Slot
booking.summary: Reserve a time slot and check its check-in deadline.
booking.step1: Select a charger and connector compatible with your vehicle's inlet.
booking.step2: Choose your preferred duration (30 min, 60 min, or 120 min).
booking.step3: Pay the displayed package price. Each booking saves the price and applicable terms when it is created.
booking.tip: Check in before the deadline recorded for your booking. If it passes, the booking will be cancelled under the no-show policy.

checkIn.title: 3. Arrive & Check In via QR Code
checkIn.summary: Park in your reserved bay and scan the current check-in code for the correct connector.
checkIn.step1: Park in the reserved charging bay and open your car's charge port door.
checkIn.step2: Open ChargeOps, view your booking details, or select 'QR Check-in'.
checkIn.step3: After scanning, check the station, connector, and time in the preview, then confirm in the app to complete check-in.
checkIn.tip: Check-in codes expire. If a code is expired or invalid, get a fresh code for the correct connector and scan again. The charger ID cannot replace the check-in QR code.

charging.title: 4. Plug In & Monitor Live Session
charging.summary: Review booking status, the reserved time window, and configured connector details.
charging.step1: Connect the charging cable according to the station and vehicle instructions.
charging.step2: Follow the equipment indicators and station instructions; indicators can vary by equipment.
charging.step3: The app shows booking status, the reserved window, connector type, and configured power. It does not currently show live measured power, battery SoC, delivered kWh, or actual electricity cost.
charging.tip: When you are ready to finish, tap 'End charging session' in the app to update the booking status.

cancellation.title: 5. Cancellation & Refund Policy
cancellation.summary: Refund eligibility depends on the status and deadline saved for each booking.
cancellation.step1: If the system processes an eligible cancellation before its saved refund deadline, the refund is 100% of the package price paid.
cancellation.step2: If a station incident affects your booking, submit a support ticket. A technical finding does not decide or execute a refund; track any refund record separately.
cancellation.step3: If you have not checked in by the deadline recorded for your booking, it will be cancelled under the no-show policy.
cancellation.tip: In the demo, refund outcomes are processed by the Simulator and do not confirm a bank transfer. Check the refund record in Booking History.

safety.title: 6. Emergency Handling & Support Tickets
safety.summary: Emergency stop button and how to file support tickets with station technicians.
safety.step1: In case of fire, smoke, or extreme overheating: Immediately press the red mechanical Emergency Stop button on the charger.
safety.step2: If the charger errors out or the cable is stuck: Safely unlatch and notify station staff.
safety.step3: Submit a support ticket in the app with photos/descriptions for technical review and refund resolution.
safety.tip: You can track ticket progress and chat directly with technicians under 'My Support Tickets'.

connectorType.q: How do I know which connector my EV uses?
connectorType.a: Most modern EVs in Vietnam (VinFast VF5–VF9, BYD, Porsche Taycan, Hyundai Ioniq 5, BMW iX, etc.) use DC CCS2 for fast charging and AC Type 2 for standard charging. You can filter chargers by CCS2 or Type 2 directly in search.

lateArrival.q: What happens if I do not check in before my booking deadline?
lateArrival.a: The check-in deadline is saved for each booking; by default, it is 15 minutes before the end time. At or after the deadline, a booking without check-in is cancelled under the no-show policy and is generally not refundable. You can create a new booking if a slot is available.

qrError.q: What if the QR code fails to scan on the charger?
qrError.a: Check your connection, clean the camera lens, or use the flashlight. If the check-in code is expired or invalid, get a fresh code for the correct connector and scan again. The charger ID cannot replace the check-in QR code.

refundTiming.q: How can I check whether a refund is being processed?
refundTiming.a: You pay a package price, not a deposit credited against an actual electricity bill. If a booking is eligible for a refund, check its record in Booking History. The demo uses a Simulator and does not represent a real bank transaction.

blockedSlot.q: What if an unauthorized car is parked in my reserved bay?
blockedSlot.a: Open your Booking Details, tap 'Report Issue' and select 'Bay Blocked / ICEing'. Station management and parking staff will intervene promptly.
